title: Iron Maiden Will Tour North America One Last Time in 2027
summary:
The heavy metal band Iron Maiden will play more shows in North America in 2027. It will be the third and final part of its Run for Your Lives tour, which celebrates the band's 50th anniversary.

The band shared the news on Friday, October 16. Iron Maiden had planned to take a break in 2027. But bass player Steve Harris said the band was enjoying its shows so much that it wanted to visit places it had missed.

The tour starts April 14, 2027, in Tacoma, Washington. It ends May 11 in Belmont Park, New York. Other stops include Phoenix, Dallas and Atlanta.

Two other British bands, Bullet For My Valentine and The Raven Age, will join them.

After the tour, Iron Maiden will play at two music festivals, in Ohio and Maryland. Harris said festivals are "always a challenge and we all love a challenge!"

By the end, the tour will have had 107 shows.
why_it_matters: It shows how musicians plan trips so fans in many places can see them play.
